name: Video-Captioning-Generation-Benchmark-Example
description: A small example dataset for video caption generation that provides short videos (or video clips) with associated ground-truth captions. It is intended to measure a model's ability to generate descriptive, temporally coherent natural-language summaries of video content. Evaluation typically compares generated captions to references using automatic n-gram and consensus metrics.
reputation: A lightweight example dataset hosted on Hugging Face, primarily used for prototyping and demonstration rather than large-scale benchmarking.
